【原视频简介】
Artist and puppet maker Laura Mathews ( @LauraMathewsArt  ) is back in Adam's shop to show her latest build: sets of life-size articulated wings inspired by real-life bird anatomy and biological mechanics! Adam marvels at the elegant movement of these wings and puts on a set himself to experience their articulation firsthand. 

Find more of Laura's puppets and projects here: https://www.lauramathewsart.com/ and https://www.youtube.com/LauraMathewsArt
Laura's articulated creature kits: https://www.lauramathewsart.com/shop-1

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
